LanguageData.PhobosHitch_HitchGizmoDesc: Choose a trailer standing within {CELLS} cells. A colonist walks over and couples it, and it is set straight behind this vehicle. The trailer and all it carries then add to the weight the engine must pull.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_CancelGizmoDesc: Stop waiting for {TRAILER} to be coupled.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_UnhitchGizmoDesc: Let {TRAILER} go where it stands. It stays there, loaded, until a vehicle hitches it again.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_NotOurs: {TRAILER} is not ours. Claim it first.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_CouplingMismatch: {TRAILER} couples by a {COUPLING}, and the hitch of {TRACTOR} has only: {HITCHES}. Fit an adapter to the hitch, or use a vehicle with that coupling.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_DrawbarBroken: The drawbar of {TRAILER} is broken: there is nothing to couple to until it is repaired.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_TooFar: {TRAILER} is too far away. Park within {CELLS} cells of it.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_NoRoom: There is no room behind {TRACTOR} for {TRAILER}. Clear the ground behind it, or park somewhere more open.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_CannotFollow: The trailer cannot follow: {TRAILER} would run into something, so {TRACTOR} has stopped. Take a wider way round, or unhitch it.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_LeftBehind: {TRAILER} stays behind: it could not be taken along on the journey.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_NoRoomToSetDown: There is no room near {TRACTOR} to set {TRAILER} down. It stays on the tow bar; clear some ground or move {TRACTOR}.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_SetDownLetGo: {TRAILER} is set down beside {TRACTOR}, unhitched: there is no room behind {TRACTOR} for it to follow from here. Move {TRACTOR} to open ground and hitch it up again.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_SetDownFailed: {TRAILER} could not be set down and is still on the tow bar. Move to open ground and it will be set down there.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_HeldGear: Held to gear {GEAR} by the engine's power.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_HeldPower: Held back by the engine's power.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_HeldGrip: Held back: the wheels cannot grip.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_CrawlPower: Crawling: the engine has not the power for it.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_OutlookFull: On this ground {TRACTOR} can pull {TRAILER} at full speed ({TRAIN} kg in all).
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_OutlookSlowed: On this ground {TRACTOR} would be slowed by {REASON} with {TRAILER} behind ({TRAIN} kg in all).
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_OutlookCrawls: On this ground {TRACTOR} could only crawl with {TRAILER} behind, for want of {REASON} ({TRAIN} kg in all).
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_OutlookTooHeavy: {TRAILER} is too heavy for {TRACTOR} to tow ({TRAIN} kg in all).
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_WorkingFull: Working in the ground, {TRACTOR} would keep its speed.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_WorkingSlowed: Working in the ground, {TRACTOR} would be slowed by {REASON}.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_WorkingCrawls: Working in the ground, {TRACTOR} could only crawl, for want of {REASON}.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_OwnHalfOnly: {TRAILER} joins only its own front half.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_PivotOnly: The hitch of {TRACTOR} is the pivot for its own rear half, and takes nothing else.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_NoEngine: {TRAILER} has no engine and no seat: hitch it to a vehicle to move it.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_CaravanNotHitched: Not hitched. A trailer cannot drive itself: hitch it behind a vehicle going in this caravan, and it goes along with that vehicle.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_CaravanGoesWithTractor: Hitched: it goes with the vehicle towing it, and is chosen whenever that vehicle is. Its load counts with the caravan's.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_CaravanLeftUnhitched: {TRAILER} was not hitched to anything, so it stays behind.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_InspectPlainCap: Held to {CAP} of its speed by the weight behind it.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_InspectDrawbarBroken: Its drawbar is broken: it cannot be towed until it is repaired.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_SettingOthers: Vehicles without the drivetrain model can tow
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_SettingOthersDesc: Off by default: only vehicles whose engine, gears and grip the drivetrain model works out can tow, and for them a heavy trailer slows the climb, runs the engine hotter and burns more fuel. On, every other land vehicle can tow too, but on a plain rule only: it keeps its own weight's share of its speed, whatever its engine, the ground or the hill. A small car pulling a loaded trailer will crawl; a big truck barely notices.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_SettingWiderWay: Vehicles that tow take a wider way round
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_SettingWiderWayDesc: On by default. A vehicle towing a trailer keeps away from walls, fences and rock where it can, so the trailer has room to cut the corners behind it. Its route is also checked for the trailer before it sets off: where the trailer would not fit, it looks for another way round, and says so if there is none. Off, a vehicle that tows takes the same way it would alone, and stops wherever its trailer cannot follow.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_NoWideWay: {TRACTOR} found no way round wide enough for {TRAILER}. It sets off anyway, and will stop where the trailer cannot follow: choose a more open way, or unhitch it.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_PackUpFirst: {TRAILER} is set up where it stands. Pack it up first.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_SetUpOnTheWay: A colonist is on the way to set up {TRAILER}. Cancel that first.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_ChainLoop: {TRAILER} is already pulling {TRACTOR}, so {TRACTOR} cannot pull it.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_ChainTrailersOnly: {TRACTOR} is being towed itself, so it can take only a trailer or an implement behind it, not {TRAILER}.
LanguageData.PhobosHitch_ChainTooLong: {TRACTOR} already pulls as long a line as it can: at most {COUNT} behind it.
LanguageData.PhobosArticulated_NoRoom: {VEHICLE} has no room behind it for its rear half. Clear the cells behind it; it will try again.
LanguageData.PhobosArticulated_HitchTaken: {VEHICLE} cannot be joined to its rear half while {TRAILER} is on its pivot. Unhitch {TRAILER}; it will try again.
